name: bfj
reason: snarkjs → bfj: imported by snarkjs/cli.js only (the command line), never by build/browser.esm.js, the prover the wallet bundles; the advisory (uncontrolled resource consumption on untrusted JSON streams) needs a JSON stream the CLI would parse. Re-check when snarkjs moves past bfj 7.

name: jsonpath
reason: snarkjs → bfj → jsonpath: the same CLI-only chain; no fixed release exists (advisory range *). Not in the browser bundle (scripts/audit.mjs documents the check: grep bfj build/browser.esm.js → 0).

name: underscore
reason: snarkjs → bfj → jsonpath → underscore: the same CLI-only chain; the vulnerable template function is never called by the wallet (nothing from jsonpath is bundled).
